goal: Build and verify the Electron React TypeScript product shell for frontend Web project selection and task conversation.
acceptance: User can select a placeholder frontend Web project.
User can enter a task conversation page showing project and progress.
Unit, type, build, interaction, CI, and local EXE evidence are complete before manual approval.
verified: Phase 1 task record exists in Markdown.
Foundation tooling and product shell checks are recorded as complete.
last_push_status: synchronized: origin/master matched phase-1 delivery commit
next_step: User manually verifies the Phase 1 flow and explicitly approves the phase.
progress_commit_policy: Commit and push each appropriately sized, coherent, independently verifiable milestone to origin; do not commit every small edit.
phase_stop_policy: Continue all planned Phase 1 nodes; pause only at the completed automated acceptance gate for explicit user manual approval, or for a defined blocker.
